reference: SELECTION OF KITCHEN CONSULTANT FOR THE PROPOSED CIAL EMPLOYEE CAFETERIA BUILDING AT CIAL

tender.description: The SOW covers consultancy services for planning, design, commissioning and operationalization of a modern kitchen facility for the proposed Employee Cafeteria, supporting CIAL/CIL from concept stage to full operational readiness.
